nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

description: Query Etsy products with multi-dimensional filters (keyword/URL, price, sales, favorites, reviews, listing date, category, handmade/vintage types, Pick/Bestseller/Raving tags). Trigger when user mentions Etsy products, Etsy listings, Etsy product sourcing, Etsy bestsellers, Etsy handmade, Etsy vintage, Etsy items, or Etsy product query — even if the tool name is not mentioned, as long as the need is to search products, view sales/price/tags, or filter items on Etsy.

beginFavorites.description: Favorite count (start), combined with end value to form the upstream favorites range

beginFavoritesWeekly.description: Weekly new favorites (start), combined with end value to form the upstream favorites_weekly range

beginPrice.description: Price (start), combined with end price to form the upstream price range (e.g., 20~100). When only one side is provided, the upstream returns start~ or ~end

beginReviews.description: Review count (start), combined with end value to form the upstream reviews range

beginReviewsWeekly.description: Weekly new reviews (start), combined with end value to form the upstream reviews_weekly range

beginSales.description: Total sales (start), combined with end value to form the upstream sales range

beginSalesWeekly.description: Weekly sales (start), combined with end value to form the upstream sales_weekly range (e.g., 1~100)

category.description: Product category ID (single category), see the Category Query API

endPrice.description: Price (end), combined with start price to form the upstream price range

isBestsell.description: Whether the product is a bestseller

isPick.description: Whether the product is a Pick item

isRaving.description: Whether the product is a Raving item

listedTime.description: Listing time no earlier than this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

pageSize.description: Items per page, default 20, max 100, recommended not to exceed 50

searchKey.description: Search keyword or Etsy product URL

sortBy.description: Sort field (corresponds to upstream sort_by, values 1~6)

sortDesc.description: Sort direction (corresponds to upstream desc). Schema example: descending 1, ascending 2 (encoding differs from store query's sortDesc)

name: nexscope_etsy_product_query
title: Etsy Product Query
